strategy.name: Pine · TSMOM intraday ORB
strategy.description: Daily direction-filtered ORB with signal-close entries, a dollar-risk budget, stop/target brackets, one attempt per session, and a force-flat window.
strategy.migration_scope: Pine rules port with one-minute bracket execution. Stop wins ties within a minute; gap fills use the opening price. No TradingView sub-minute Bar Magnifier or order-fill recalculation emulation. A rejected risk-sized attempt still consumes the session.
